name: io.github.ProAnima/uvcs-mcp
title: UVCS MCP
description: Safe Plastic SCM / Unity Version Control MCP: history, review, merge preview, and guarded writes.

environmentVariables.name: UVCS_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the Plastic SCM / Unity Version Control workspace (the folder that contains .plastic).

environmentVariables.name: UVCS_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: readonly (default) for inspection only; standard enables prepare/confirm write tools.

environmentVariables.name: UVCS_ALLOWED_WORKSPACES
environmentVariables.description: Workspace paths the server may use, separated by ';'. Set it to UVCS_WORKSPACE to pin the workspace.

environmentVariables.name: UVCS_ALLOWED_REPOS
environmentVariables.description: repository@server:port identities the workspace must match, separated by ';' (the guarded profile).

environmentVariables.name: UVCS_CM_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the cm executable when it is not on PATH (GUI clients on macOS often need it).
